openimages-cvdf-v5-boxable.notes: The 561 GB CVDF tar mirror is the 1,743,042-image V4/V5 boxable training subset, not complete Open Images. Use the matching boxable image-information snapshot. Never use Thumbnail300KURL as canonical bytes.

smithsonian-open-access.anonymous_access: HTTPS or S3 --no-sign-request; no account or API key required
smithsonian-open-access.notes: Collect and preserve explicitly selected unit/shard bytes with collect-smithsonian --snapshot-dir; require byte-identical offline replay, both metadata_usage.access and selected media usage.access to equal CC0, and prefer High-resolution JPEG.

wikimedia-commons.notes: Collect reviewed File titles with collect-commons and verify every resulting file page and revision.
